articles.summary: Russian missile crash in Poland likely an intentional provocation as European militaries hold drills, Polish leader says

articles.title: Verdict reached in Los Angeles retrial over 2025 Pacific Palisades wildfire that killed 12 people
articles.summary: Jonathan Rinderknecht was convicted of federal arson in the Pacific Palisades fire that killed 12 and destroyed nearly 7,000 homes after a mistrial.

articles.title: Federal jury convicts man of starting the deadly 2025 Palisades Fire in Los Angeles
articles.summary: Prosecutors argued the defendant, 30-year-old Jonathan Rinderknecht, had been "mad at everything" in the days leading up to the January 2025 fire, which killed 12 people.

articles.title: Most famous unsolved maths riddle solved by AI giant Anthropic after 167 years
articles.summary: Turkish-American mathematician Dr Levent Alpöge, 34, (pictured) claimed on Friday to have found the answer to the Riemann Hypothesis using Claude, Anthropic's AI chatbot.

articles.title: Anthropic worker claims to have solved a Holy Grail of math problems with the help of AI
articles.summary: A mathematician who works for artificial intelligence giant Anthropic claims he has solved a Holy Grail of math problems with the help of the company's AI tool Claude. It marks the second time in recent months that an AI company or someone linked to one claims to have cracked a famed unsolved math…

articles.title: Trump releases never-before-seen UFO video showing mystery object overtaking warship… as new files expose notorious Skinwalker Ranch's vault for 'exotic tissue'
articles.summary: The [outlet] has exclusively obtained never-before-seen videos and once-secret files on UFOs as the Trump administration prepares to release its latest tranche of government records.

articles.title: New UFO files show contractor planned vault for "exotic material"
articles.summary: The Pentagon's latest batch of UFO files includes a report from a government contractor detailing plans for an underground vault to store "exotic material or tissue" it was seeking.

articles.title: British ocean campaigner becomes first to swim the Strait of Hormuz - saying war-torn waterway is 'one of the most beautiful places I have ever visited'
articles.summary: Lewis Pugh, 56, spent three days in the war-torn waterway this week, covering about 15km (9.3 miles) in order to 'bring attention to the devastating environmental cost of war'.

articles.title: Athlete swims Strait of Hormuz to highlight Iran war's wildlife toll
articles.summary: British endurance swimmer Lewis Pugh has swum the Strait of Hormuz to highlight environmental threats during ongoing conflict.

articles.title: Zoo shares autopsy findings following Fiona the hippo’s heartbreaking death
articles.summary: Cincinnati Zoo’s director of animal health, Dr. Mike Wenninger, said a postmortem examination has revealed where the hat was lodged inside Fiona’s digestive tract.

articles.title: Like Fiona the Hippo, Internet Famous Animals Can Bring Value to Zoos
articles.summary: Animal videos have long been popular online, but as it did with Fiona, social media can foster deeper connections that are valuable to zoos.

articles.title: Kemi Badenoch says Joanne Young's rapist husband should 'never' be released from jail
articles.summary: The Conservative leader also demanded 'the most severe punishment' for the five men he recruited to rape and assault Joanne Young, 49.

articles.title: 4 British Men Convicted of Sexually Assaulting Joanne Young
articles.summary: A jury rejected the men’s defense that they had been relying on assurances from Joanne Young’s husband — who himself has pleaded guilty to rape — that she had consented.
